{{Infobox auto}}

'''Gimmari''' are fried seaweed rolls, the meal of kelp. They heal {{Value|Gimmari|heals}} and grant {{EffectLink|Water Breathing}} for {{Value|Gimmari|duration|effect=Water Breathing}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/gimmari.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Dried Kelp|Dried kelp]], a carrot, sugar, an egg, flour and [[oil]]. Obtaining dried kelp unlocks the recipe. Crafting it gives back the oil's glass bottle.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating gimmari takes {{Value|Gimmari|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Gimmari|heals}} and gives Water Breathing for {{Value|Gimmari|duration|effect=Water Breathing|format=clock}}.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Gimmari use oil. The changelog lists a buff to 10:00 of Water Breathing and 5 hearts of healing, but the recipe still gives 8:00 and {{Hp|6}}.}}
{{History line|1.12.3|2=Crafting gimmari returns the oil's glass bottle. In 1.12.2 the advancement behind this still used an old recipe ID, so the bottle was lost.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.3|2=Villagers can pick it as their [[favorite food]] and buy it once for 1 obol.}}
{{History line|1.12.3|Eating time raised from 1.2 to 1.6 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/gimmari.json}}</ref>}}
}}
